title: fix(platform-objects): a team record no longer lists Sessions with "Sign out other devices"
body:
Fixes #24765

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Developer run for the `domain:engine` seat 1 dispatch (claim comment 6289444669), session `session_01NftZtMY2EJSyAjctCSfkis`.

## What changes

`sys_session.active_team_id` is a lookup to `sys_team`. It did not set `relatedList: false`, so every team record derived a **Sessions** related list (Setup → Teams → a team → Related). That list carried the session object's only `list_toolbar` action, "Sign out other devices". Its confirmation reads "Sign out of every other device where you're currently logged in?", and it revokes the **caller's** own other sessions, not the team's.

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-session.object.ts`: `active_team_id` now sets `relatedList: false`, with a one-line comment saying why. The field, its lookup, its label and its column stay. better-auth still writes `activeTeamId` there (`plugin-auth/src/auth-schema-config.ts`).
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-team-derived-related-lists.test.ts` (new): the pins below.
- `.changeset/24765-team-sessions-related-list.md`: `minor` for `@objectstack/platform-objects` (fix round 1: a narrowing ships `minor` in the launch window, as Check Changeset's level axis enforces), with the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` that `check-adr-0087-registration` asks of a `(narrowing)` arm.

## The read, done before the edit (base `abd5acdaf7`)

- **How a team's related lists are derived.** `sys_team` declares no record page anywhere in the repo (only `sys_organization` and `sys_user` have pages), so the console derives the team page's related lists. `FieldSchema.relatedList` says `false` suppresses the child and absent shows it. The key is `live` in `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, whose evidence is objectui `deriveRelatedLists` skipping the foreign key when `relatedList` is `false`.
- **Every lookup into `sys_team`** (all `lookup` / `master_detail` fields in `packages/` and `examples/`): `sys_session.active_team_id` (fixed here), `sys_team_member.team_id` (the team's Members list, which is wanted) and `sys_invitation.team_id`. The Invitations list on a team is named, not changed. Its toolbar action `invite_user` is org-scoped and not self-scoped. Its `accept_invitation` / `reject_invitation` row actions are visible only to the invitee (`record.email == ctx.user.email`).
- **Who reads a team's Sessions list today:** nobody. No page, test, doc, `qa/` file or `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` item names it. `identity-auth.json`'s revoke-other-sessions item is about a user's own sessions and is unchanged.
- **The user's own Sessions list** is a curated `record:related_list` tab on `SysUserDetailPage`, keyed on `sys_session.user_id`, and does not go through `active_team_id`.

## Pins

In `sys-team-derived-related-lists.test.ts`, applying the spec's derivation rule to every object this package exports:

- the derived related lists of `sys_team` exclude `sys_session` and still include `sys_team_member.team_id` (a guard against over-applying the key);
- `sys_session.active_team_id` is still a `lookup` to `sys_team` labelled "Active Team", with `relatedList: false`;
- `SysUserDetailPage` still lists `sys_session` by `user_id`; `sys_session.user_id` still derives a list on `sys_user`; `revoke_my_other_sessions` is still a `list_toolbar` action.

**Ablation**, run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed fix. The anchor `relatedList: false,` went 1 → 0 on disk and the blob went `adf2c552a667` → `55e8613a1c8f`. The file then ran **2 failed | 3 passed**: `exclude sys_session` and the declaration pin went red. Restored: blob == HEAD `adf2c552a667`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The tests import `src/` directly, so no `dist/` leg applies.

**Pin sweep:** I swept `active_team_id`, "Active Team", `revoke_my_other_sessions`, "Sign out other devices" and the confirmation text across `packages/`, `qa/`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` and `content/docs/`. No existing pin moves.

## Verification

Run at `4f4bb1fab`, which is the branch merged with `origin/main` `3fbef41b4`, unless a line says otherwise.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0. The first run went red on two type errors in the new test file, which I fixed. I did not add a ledger entry.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: exit 0, 80 files, 1204 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo`: exit 0, 6 files, 82 tests (pre-merge head).
- Dependent suites, pre-merge head: `plugin-auth` exit 0 (3240 passed, 10 skipped) · `plugin-security` exit 0 (4047 passed, 45 skipped) · `runtime` exit 0 (6782 passed, 19 skipped) · `rest` exit 0 (6144 passed, 326 skipped) · `verify` exit 0 (376 passed). The full `cli` unit layer runs longer than the 10-minute foreground cap, so I left it to CI. Its tests that read identity objects (`organization-ownership-inventory`, `unmanaged-tables`, `src/lint`) ran: exit 0, 94 passed.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` with no paths derived 66 commands, and I ran all 66. 65 exited 0 on the first pass. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no `dist/`). After `pnpm build` it exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, with every line carrying its exit code. After the merge I re-ran `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:i18n`, `check:type-check-debt` and `check:nul-bytes`: all exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs`: exit 0. All bundles are in sync, so this change regenerates no translation bundle.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not asked, not built:** a team-scoped session action, and any change to `revoke_session` or to the header action.
- This narrowing owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before the queue, run by the seat.
